mentions.name: onthe.town
mentions.description: A platform for social experience clubs, described as "Shopify for social experience clubs". Anyone can start a club and create in-person events that bring random people together around shared interests; each club gets its own website and infrastructure that handles signups, payments, and matching. It platforms the Timeleft dinner-matching concept so anyone can build a similar service around any interest, with example clubs including golf matchmaking, vinyl record sharing, biotech networking lunches, and parents meeting for dinner.
mentions.problem: The author aims to incentivize people to build in-real-life communities instead of AI-related apps, because the demand for human interaction far outweighs the supply.
mentions.audience: Anyone who wants to start and run a social experience club
mentions.source_excerpt: My platform (https://onthe.town), is basically Shopify for social experience clubs. Anyone can start a club and create events based around bringing random people together IRL based on shared interests. You get your own website and infra that handles signups, payments, and matching.
